_note: Canonical object-lifetime roles, as DATA. The reader emits alloc/dealloc lifecycle events (the typestate skeleton the matcher walks for double-free / use-after-free / leak) from THIS file -- so teaching it a new kernel allocator or free is an edit here, never a code change in the engine. Roles are memory-lifecycle facts, not taint sink/source roles, which is why they live in their own detection-layer catalog rather than the models/ sink tree.
_derivation_note: Sized allocators are NOT re-listed here: any sink in models/<lang> whose kind is in `alloc_kinds` (e.g. kmalloc, kzalloc, kcalloc -- all `alloc-size`) is already an allocation, and those models stay the single source of truth for it. The `alloc` lists below add only the size-LESS allocators (strdup-family: they return an owned pointer but carry no explicit size argument, so they never appear in the sized-sink catalog). `realloc`-family calls live in the alloc catalog (they reopen an object) and are treated as allocations.
